name: cast-side
brief:
EIGHT consecutive spell-casting frames FOUR columns TWO rows. Logical canvas512x256, cells128x128; enlarged3x ifnecessary. RIGHT-FACING THREE-QUARTER original view. Fixed small skeleton height86px, groundliney107, bodycenterx64. Body occupies only middle two thirds ofeachcell, with top andside margins16px minimum. 
Spell action: staff remains FULL LENGTH and nearly VERTICAL throughout, like a solid rigid object; casting through a raised crystal and free-hand gesture. Never point staff horizontally or foreshorten it. This avoids changing weapon length. Frame1 neutral uprightstaff;2 freehand draws to ribs, crouch2px;3 lift staff STRAIGHT UP6px, freehand rises;4 liftstaff10px, freehand opens toward target;5 release gesture freehand extended, staff raised8px;6 hold release;7 lowerstaff4px, retractfreehand;8 returnneutral. Feet planted at same coordinates. Keep crystal attached and exactlysame size, fullstaff visible down tobottom in everypose. Staff barely tilts maximum10degrees. NO magical light/glow/projectile baked into character. No frame crosses its own squarecell. Preserve skull and identity; do NOT inflate character tofill128cell.

brief: SEVEN animation frames in FOUR columns by TWO rows, cell8 EMPTY. Logicalcanvas768x384 cells192x192, enlarged2x ifnecessary.
